issue: After dragging to set an initial pose, the same gesture also opened navigation-goal confirmation.
cause: StageCard exits poseMode on the pose event emitted from pointerup; the browser's subsequent click then passed the navigation-point handler's poseMode guard.
fix: Consume the click associated with a pose gesture before emitting pose, independent of the parent's mode change or confirmation result.
Clear stale click suppression on a new primary-pointer gesture so subsequent deliberate map clicks remain usable.
Track the active pointer and cancel a drag on pointercancel or lostpointercapture; prevent pose input during preview.

validation.real_browser: System Chrome headless, real StageCard/FieldMap with API-isolated fixtures
cases_passed: Confirm pose: one pose confirmation, one pose event, zero navigation goals
Next independent click: navigation confirmation and goal still work
Cancel pose confirmation: no navigation confirmation or goal
Release captured pointer outside canvas: pose only
Cancelled pointer: no pose or goal; next deliberate navigation click works
Touch drag: one pose confirmation, zero navigation goals

deployment.public_verification: HTML references new JS/CSS; both served assets match the local build bytes
deployment.rk_source_note: RK frontend source still predated the already-published point/pose features. Matched it against known prior commits, then synchronized the four frontend source files needed for the existing published features plus this fix.
